exercise_name_th_check.name: exercise_name_th_check
exercise_name_th_check.value: "exercise"."name_th" IS NULL OR char_length("exercise"."name_th") BETWEEN 1 AND 60

exercise_catalog_fields_check.name: exercise_catalog_fields_check
exercise_catalog_fields_check.value: "exercise"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("exercise"."name_th" IS NOT NULL AND "exercise"."source_dataset" IS NOT NULL AND "exercise"."source_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "exercise"."license" IS NOT NULL AND "exercise"."attribution" IS NOT NULL AND "exercise"."deleted_at" IS NULL)

exercise_own_fields_check.name: exercise_own_fields_check
exercise_own_fields_check.value: "exercise"."owner_user_id" IS NULL OR ("exercise"."source_dataset" IS NULL AND "exercise"."source_ref" IS NULL AND "exercise"."license" IS NULL AND "exercise"."attribution" IS NULL AND "exercise"."met" IS NULL)

place_map_url_check.name: place_map_url_check
place_map_url_check.value: "place"."map_url" IS NULL OR char_length("place"."map_url") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

set_record_weight_set_check.name: set_record_weight_set_check
set_record_weight_set_check.value: ("set_record"."weight_kg" IS NULL AND "set_record"."weight_input" IS NULL AND "set_record"."weight_unit" IS NULL) OR ("set_record"."weight_kg" IS NOT NULL AND "set_record"."weight_input" IS NOT NULL AND "set_record"."weight_unit" IS NOT NULL)

set_record_distance_set_check.name: set_record_distance_set_check
set_record_distance_set_check.value: ("set_record"."distance_m" IS NULL AND "set_record"."distance_input" IS NULL AND "set_record"."distance_unit" IS NULL) OR ("set_record"."distance_m" IS NOT NULL AND "set_record"."distance_input" IS NOT NULL AND "set_record"."distance_unit" IS NOT NULL)

set_record_speed_set_check.name: set_record_speed_set_check
set_record_speed_set_check.value: ("set_record"."speed_mps" IS NULL AND "set_record"."speed_input" IS NULL AND "set_record"."speed_unit" IS NULL) OR ("set_record"."speed_mps" IS NOT NULL AND "set_record"."speed_input" IS NOT NULL AND "set_record"."speed_unit" IS NOT NULL)

set_record_weight_range_check.name: set_record_weight_range_check
set_record_weight_range_check.value: "set_record"."weight_unit" IS NULL OR ("set_record"."weight_unit" = 'kg' AND "set_record"."weight_input" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000) OR ("set_record"."weight_unit" = 'lb' AND "set_record"."weight_input" BETWEEN 0 AND 2200)

set_record_distance_range_check.name: set_record_distance_range_check
set_record_distance_range_check.value: "set_record"."distance_unit" IS NULL OR ("set_record"."distance_unit" = 'km' AND "set_record"."distance_input" BETWEEN 0.01 AND 1000) OR ("set_record"."distance_unit" = 'mi' AND "set_record"."distance_input" BETWEEN 0.01 AND 620)

set_record_speed_range_check.name: set_record_speed_range_check
set_record_speed_range_check.value: "set_record"."speed_unit" IS NULL OR ("set_record"."speed_unit" = 'kmh' AND "set_record"."speed_input" BETWEEN 0.1 AND 40) OR ("set_record"."speed_unit" = 'mph' AND "set_record"."speed_input" BETWEEN 0.1 AND 25)

workout_session_span_check.name: workout_session_span_check
workout_session_span_check.value: "workout_session"."ended_at" IS NULL OR ("workout_session"."ended_at" >= "workout_session"."started_at" AND "workout_session"."ended_at" <= "workout_session"."started_at" + interval '24 hours')
